# truenas_system_general (Data Source)

Reads the current TrueNAS system general configuration (management UI, timezone, keyboard map, usage collection). Takes no arguments: there is exactly one system general configuration per TrueNAS system.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ds_auth` (Boolean) Whether directory service credentials may be used to log in to the web UI.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton: always "system_general".
- `kbdmap` (String) System console keyboard layout/map.
- `timezone` (String) System timezone (e.g. "America/Los_Angeles").
- `ui_address` (List of String) IPv4 addresses the web UI binds to.
- `ui_allowlist` (List of String) IP addresses/networks allowed to access the web UI. Empty list allows all.
- `ui_certificate` (Number) Numeric ID of the certificate used by the web UI for HTTPS.
- `ui_certificate_name` (String) Name of the certificate currently assigned to the web UI.
- `ui_consolemsg` (Boolean) Whether console messages are shown on the login screen.
- `ui_httpsport` (Number) TCP port the web UI listens on for HTTPS.
- `ui_httpsprotocols` (List of String) TLS protocol versions accepted by the web UI (e.g. TLSv1.2, TLSv1.3).
- `ui_httpsredirect` (Boolean) Whether HTTP requests to the web UI are redirected to HTTPS.
- `ui_port` (Number) TCP port the web UI listens on for HTTP.
- `ui_v6address` (List of String) IPv6 addresses the web UI binds to.
- `ui_x_frame_options` (String) X-Frame-Options header value sent by the web UI. One of SAMEORIGIN, DENY, ALLOW_ALL.
- `usage_collection` (Boolean) Whether anonymous usage statistics are collected.
- `usage_collection_is_set` (Boolean) Whether usage_collection has been explicitly set by an administrator.
- `wizardshown` (Boolean) Whether the initial setup wizard has been shown.
